statement: Under the declared L1 NVML boundary, GPTQ reduces mWh per forced 256 completion tokens by more than 2% relative to AWQ.

boundary.energy: NVML GPU board-power telemetry integrated over concurrent request windows on two RTX 5090 GPUs.
boundary.service: Eight concurrent fixed-prompt requests per format session, forced to 256 completion tokens.

threshold_rationale.status: post-collection illustrative L1 screen; not a universal default

required_gate_set_complete.evidence: current release registry comparison is performed by the evaluator.

runtime_provenance_status.evidence: Driver, firmware, power cap, clock policy, temperature trace and immutable runtime commit were not preserved.

design_integrity.evidence: Physical-GPU mapping, time period and unrecorded platform state are inseparable after one map exchange.

mapping_period_separability.evidence: Only one exchange occurred after block 5; mapping and period cannot be separated.

serial_dependence_assessed.evidence: Ten sequential blocks and the one-exchange design do not support a reliable serial-dependence assessment.

continuous_duration.evidence: 17.183-18.486 s is below the declared post-collection 25-s screen.

integration_stability.evidence: p95 stride-2 absolute difference 0.0818 percentage points.

benefit_threshold.evidence: Mean GPTQ reduction -1.287%; it does not meet the >2% claim.

dependence_compatible_interval.evidence: The historical iid t interval was not predeclared or shown compatible with potential block dependence.

permitted_wording: Not assessable with available evidence: the post-hoc L1 duration, design/provenance and dependence-compatible-inference dependencies are not satisfied.
